domain: BioDigitalTwin x Human Systems Research OS
purpose: Route human-systems research across biological, psychological/contextual, operator-observed, bioenergetic-model and symbolic/material lanes while preserving evidence class, provenance, time and uncertainty.

product_model.relationship: BioDigitalTwin holds typed evolving subject/reference state; Human Systems Research OS coordinates specialist evidence, comparison, experiments and learning around it.

public_lanes.scope: anatomy, physiology, laboratory/device and clinical evidence
self-report, context, behavior, recovery and psychological models
declared protocol-based operator observations and repeatability
centers, channels, coherence and field models as model/research constructs
metaphysical source models, mineral/material context, traditions and meaning

state_container_rule: BioDigitalTwin is a typed research/state representation, not a global truth source or a diagnosis engine.
research_rule: When plausible interpretations compete, prefer the next safe observation or experiment that can reduce uncertainty rather than forcing narrative convergence.
privacy_rule: Shared base_core stores no private BioDigitalTwin subject state. Real-person state belongs only in explicitly authorized scoped storage.
